description: Raised 2026-10-07 with pane names. muster msg shows a local pane participant as 'otter (p29te12q4t)', but one on another machine still as its id with @machine, because the name is refreshed only from this daemon's own panes. Documented in limits. Fix: carry the far pane's name across the link the way called is carried for local ones.
title: msg shows a pane participant on another machine by its id, not its name
